title: Migrate tables that older installs created before their columns existed
message:
Migrate tables that older installs created before their columns existed

weather_cache.wind_speed, player_save_objs.idx_name, and the room-keyed
hint_usage_log columns were only in create statements, which never touch
an existing table. Production lacked wind_speed and idx_name (every
character object load scanned 508k rows), and both production and dev
kept a region-keyed hint_usage_log that rejected every log_hint_usage()
insert.

run_legacy_table_migrations() adds them as versioned, idempotent
migrations 2026092701-03 on every boot. They repair lookup and analytics
tables, so a failure is logged and retried rather than stopping boot.
The ad-hoc wind_speed ALTER in the create path is now redundant.
